# Domain Map

## Current Top-Level Areas
- `Areas/CodingPractices/`: code review, maintainability, mapping, testing strategy, and engineering habits.
- `Areas/Data Stores/`: relational databases, NoSQL systems, warehousing, storage services, and persistence topics.
- `Areas/DevOps/`: automation, delivery, containers, scripts, cloud operations, and environment workflows.
- `Areas/DotNet/`: C#, .NET runtime, framework, and language-feature topics.
- `Areas/GameDev/`: engine-specific and engine-agnostic game development topics.
- `Areas/Patterns/`: architecture, system design, application patterns, concurrency, and code-level design.
- `Areas/SourceControl/`: version-control workflows and related topics.

## Placement Heuristics
- Choose the area that best matches the primary question a reader would ask.
- If a topic spans two areas, place it in the stronger primary area and bridge the rest with wikilinks.
- Prefer updating an existing note over creating a sibling note with overlapping scope.
- Extend the taxonomy with the smallest viable subfolder before proposing a new top-level area.
